completeness.why: All five provider link functions keep only their bank lookup and hand the upgrade/insert, payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event to linkBankSyncAccount; the preserved differences (GoCardless mask/official_name, Pluggy fileId, Akahu tables) are passed as explicit arguments, and EnableBanking's unreachable id check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters match the real variation (newAccountFields, optional fileId, syncedTables, syncSource) with no speculative options and the inconsistencies explicit at each call site; syncedTables is required everywhere though only Akahu deviates, so the default ['transactions','accounts'] is restated four times.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied link sequence was removed from all five sites and lives only in linkBankSyncAccount.
